description: This file is a PHP script that generates an HTML page with a scrolling list of team members, including founders and developers, with some dynamic styling based on request parameters. It appears to be part of a larger SugarCRM or SuiteCRM module related to popup interfaces.

methods.name: stopNotice
methods.description: Function to stop the scrolling notice animation.

methods.name: startNotice
methods.description: Function to start the scrolling notice animation.

methods.name: scrollNotice
methods.description: Function to animate scrolling of notices by updating the position of the notice body element.

methods.name: nextNotice
methods.description: Initializes the notice body position and measures its height for scrolling.
